skillsFile.offer: Share this project's skills: a file listing them, so everyone who opens the project gets the same ones.
skillsFile.createDescription: It lists the agents and the skills here that came from a repository, with the exact commits pinned when you apply it. Commit it with the project; teammates apply it in the app or with loadout project apply.
skillsFile.noSources: None of this project's skills came from a repository, so the file starts with no sources. Add [[sources]] to it by hand.
skillsFile.nothing: Nothing to do: every skill is already in place.
skillsFile.unknownAgents: No agent here called {{names}}; they get nothing.
skillsFile.prune: Also remove skills the file no longer lists (only ones Loadout wrote and nobody changed)
skillsFile.force: Also replace or remove folders changed by hand (the old ones go to Recently removed)
skillsFile.removedNote_one: {{count}} folder removed; it waits in Recently removed.
skillsFile.removedNote_other: {{count}} folders removed; they wait in Recently removed.
skillsFile.unapplied_one: Removed {{count}} applied folder. It waits in Recently removed.
skillsFile.unapplied_other: Removed {{count}} applied folders. They wait in Recently removed.

description.apply: Each skill is copied from its pinned commit into the project's agent folders. Your library is not touched.
description.update: Every source moves to the newest commit of its branch or tag, and the pins in skills-lock.json change.
description.unapply: Folders {{file}} wrote are removed and wait in Recently removed. The file and its lock stay.
